description: Zillow Home Value Index for the selected Ohio county and middle-price-tier SFR/condo housing category.
transformation_rule: Use the March, June, September, and December month-end observations as Q1, Q2, Q3, and Q4 values.
missing_value_rule: Leave source missing values missing; do not interpolate.
